name: The Professor
description: PROPOSED (see launchpad/Research/the-professor-skill-suite-redesign.md — not yet built): a portable Skill-suite plugin — scan a target repo, draft and maintain its documentation library, and keep per-section provenance, pointed at any repo, not just one handbook. The six skills are the distributable unit, installable into whatever agent already exists; the bundled persona is an optional companion, not a requirement.
